name: Atlas Super Club
priceRange: Entry / One-Night Pass: starting from ~Rp 100.000 (general admission) up to ~Rp 150.000 depending on night & gender promos; day-bed / VIP & day-club rates from ~Rp 500.000 and up.
description: is Bali's largest nightclub, located at Atlas Beach Fest in Canggu. It is a premium, three-level venue with a high-energy atmosphere, known for its industrial design, massive lighting and sound systems, and top DJs. The club operates seven days a week and features different themed nights.
